title: Sindh Local Government Seventh Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Seventh Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLII OF 2002
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (SEVENTH) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLII OF
2002
An Ordinance to further amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 31st October, 2002]
No.S.Legis:1(42)/2002, dated
31-10-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Local
Government (Seventh Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Seventh Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 156 of Sindh Ordinance XXVII of 2001

ORDINANCE XLII OF 2002
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (SEVENTH) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLII OF
2002
An Ordinance to further amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 31st October, 2002]
No.S.Legis:1(42)/2002, dated
31-10-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 156 of
Sindh Ordinance XXVII of 2001.- In the Sindh Local -Government Ordinance,
2001, in section 156, in sub section (4), for the words "within sixty
days" and in subsection (5), for the words "within thirty days",
the words and commas "within, as far as practicable, one hundred and
twenty days" shall be substituted.
